findings.current: With the imperial family involved, this couldn’t be treated as some personal act of rebellion.
findings.defect: “Personal act of rebellion” narrows the point. Taekyung fears the affair cannot be dismissed as one person’s misconduct, leaving his family exposed.
findings.rationale: 개인의 일탈 means an individual transgression, not specifically an individual rebellion.
findings.replacement: With the imperial family involved, this couldn’t be dismissed as one person’s wrongdoing.
findings.source: 황실과 관련된 이상, 이건 개인의 일탈로 취급될 수 있는 일이 아니다.

findings.current: The Director—the East Depot’s Chief Eunuch, the Chief Eunuch of the Seal—had urged his like-minded comrades to survive by becoming weeds like that.
findings.defect: The draft turns the specific Seal-Holding Eunuch title into two generic Chief Eunuch titles.
findings.rationale: 장인태감 identifies the eunuch who holds the seal; 동창의 수장 separately identifies him as head of the East Depot.
findings.replacement: The Director, the East Depot’s head and its Seal-Holding Eunuch, had urged his like-minded comrades to survive by becoming weeds like that.
findings.source: 동창의 수장인 장인태감(掌印太監). 즉 창공은 뜻을 함께하는 동지들에게 바로 그런 잡초가 되어 살아남기를 종용했다.

findings.current: If you fall that deeply asleep while you’re supposed to be standing guard, they could do anything to you except pluck out a hair.
findings.defect: The draft makes Mujin the person intruders could touch. Taekyung means Mujin’s sleep would leave Taekyung himself unprotected, prompting Mujin’s mistaken sexual interpretation.
findings.rationale: Mujin immediately asks who has already laid a hand on the Captain, confirming that Taekyung is the implied target.
findings.replacement: If my bodyguard sleeps that soundly, they could lay hands on every part of me but a single hair.
findings.source: 호법이라는 새끼가 그 정도로 깊게 잠들면 털끝 하나 빼고 다 손댔겠다.

findings.current: But I had to hold back, thinking of the Embroidered Uniform Guard rushing over the moment they heard a commotion, like a rapid response team.
findings.defect: “Rapid response team” replaces the narrator’s conspicuous Buster Call reference with a generic comparison.
findings.rationale: 버스터콜 is the narrator’s chosen pop-cultural image for the overwhelming response he expects.
findings.replacement: But I held back, imagining the Embroidered Uniform Guard receiving a Buster Call and rushing over the moment I caused a commotion.
findings.source: 소란과 동시에 버스터콜을 받고 달려올 금의위를 생각해서 꾹 참아야 했다.

findings.current: If we helped them enthrone Prince Shangshan as the new Son of Heaven, we’d receive an appropriate reward.
findings.defect: “We” blurs the distinction between Taekyung, who is being asked to help, and Ma Sanbao’s faction, which offers the reward.
findings.rationale: 자신들을 도와 refers to helping Ma Sanbao and his allies; the narrator is weighing the offer made to him.
findings.replacement: If I helped them enthrone Prince Shangshan as the new Son of Heaven, they would give me a fitting reward.
findings.source: 자신들을 도와 상산왕을 새로운 천자로 옹립한다면, 그에 마땅한 보상이 주어질 것이라고.

findings.defect: Mujin is insisting that he was not asleep, not agreeing that his snoring woke the Emperor.
findings.rationale: His next line offers proof that he was awake, and his later question shows he does not know whether the Emperor woke up.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but several passages change who bears the risk, misstate an East Depot title, or lose a joke’s referent.
